VI.description: Round20 multi-VI demo subVI (P6): plain arithmetic - Divide x by y. Panel: x in (conIdx0, required), y in (conIdx1, required), Mean out (conIdx2, recommended). Type note measured in this round: int32/int32 through Divide yields DBL, so Mean is double - the caller wires that DBL across its own connector pane, making the int-to-DBL promotion part of the test.
